entries.zh:
fields:
  delay_seconds:
    name: 玄關燈延遲秒數
    description: 幾秒後關玄關燈
    default: 30
    selector:
      number:
        min: 5
        max: 300
        unit_of_measurement: 秒
entries.en:
fields:
  delay_seconds:
    name: Entrance light delay seconds
    description: Turn off the entrance light in a few seconds
    default: 30
    selector:
      number:
        min: 5
        max: 300
        unit_of_measurement: seconds

entries.zh:
alias: nag_until_laundry_picked
mode: restart
sequence:
  - repeat:
      until:
        - condition: state
          entity_id: binary_sensor.laundry_motion
          state: "on"
      sequence:
        - action: notify.mobile_app_dad
          data:
            message: 洗衣機洗完了，快去拿！
        - delay: "00:03:00"
entries.en:
alias: nag_until_laundry_picked
mode: restart
sequence:
  - repeat:
      until:
        - condition: state
          entity_id: binary_sensor.laundry_motion
          state: "on"
      sequence:
        - action: notify.mobile_app_dad
          data:
            message: The washing machine has finished washing, go and get it!
        - delay: "00:03:00"
